newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed steady at 41.15 to the dollar in the kerb market on Friday amid an improved demand for the U.S. currency, dealers said.
They said the rise in the demand for the dollar was likely to keep the rupee steady at open on Saturday.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed steady at 2.90 percent.
